summary: Our project outer space generator makes it fun to learn about space while trying to get better planets and space items. This falls under the space mission design game category because it is a clicker game on scratch where you have to click the generate button to have a chance of spawning new planets/space objects. Even little kids can play our game to build an understanding of what space objects look like and some cool facts about them. We are just two middle school kids who like space and would hope to work at NASA one day and thought this game would help build little future rocket scientist. We have two accounts on scratch DGH- and space kid43. We worked very hard on this and even if it doesn't win we just hope other kids can have fun and learn from our game.
details: Our project uploads new space objects based on rarity. It works in scratch through a strong background code to spawn new items every time you click generate. The befits of using this is for fun or for example if you have a test and have to recognize planets but don't want to study all you would have to do is play our game. Our original intent for this project was just for fun. Our project is creative because we came up with a whole game and made it better. We combined scratches resources with our brains to create this project.
